text: Wolf Fang Source Battlecry! pg. 107 Price 300 gp Ammunition shatterstones (2 gp, 4 Bulk) --- Usage mounted Space 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 8 feet high Crew 2 to 3 Proficiency martial --- AC 18 Fort +12 Ref +6 Hardness 10 HP 80 Immunities object immunities --- Speed 15 feet (pulled or pushed) --- Orcs pioneered the invention of this siege engine, which merges the concepts of battering ram and catapult. A large stone block, one end honed to be like the engine’s namesake wolf fang, is attached to a wooden arm that can be winched back. When the lever is pulled, the arm swings the block forward with great force, the stone piercing almost any object directly ahead of it. Aim Single Action rotate 45° Load Two Actions (manipulate) 2 times, requires a successful DC 20 Athletics check Launch Single Action (attack, manipulate, reach 10 feet) The wolf fang makes a melee Strike at a +10 bonus against a structure or an unattended, stationary object directly in front of it. This Strike deals 5d8 piercing damage, ignoring Hardness 4 or lower.

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 107 **Price** 300 gp **Ammunition** shatterstones (2 gp, 4 Bulk) --- **Usage** mounted **Space** 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 8 feet high **Crew** 2 to 3 **Proficiency** martial --- **AC** 18 **Fort** +12 **Ref** +6 **Hardness** 10 **HP** 80 **Immunities** object immunities --- **Speed** 15 feet (pulled or pushed) --- Orcs pioneered the invention of this siege engine, which merges the concepts of battering ram and catapult. A large stone block, one end honed to be like the engine’s namesake wolf fang, is attached to a wooden arm that can be winched back. When the lever is pulled, the arm swings the block forward with great force, the stone piercing almost any object directly ahead of it.
**Aim** rotate 45°
**Load** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) 2 times, requires a successful DC 20 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check
**Launch** ([attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540), manipulate, [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)) The wolf fang makes a melee Strike at a +10 bonus against a structure or an unattended, stationary object directly in front of it. This Strike deals 5d8 piercing damage, ignoring [Hardness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2183) 4 or lower.
